task_description: Agents need to collaboratively search multiple online databases and repositories to gather information on recent advancements in renewable energy technologies, synthesize their findings, and produce a comprehensive research report.
expected_outcome: Agents successfully gather accurate data, reconcile conflicting information, synthesize findings correctly, and produce a well-attributed, comprehensive research report on renewable energy technologies.

agents.description: This agent is responsible for gathering information from online databases and repositories.
This agent verifies the accuracy of the collected data and checks for conflicts.
This agent synthesizes information from the verified data and prepares it for reporting.
This agent compiles the synthesized data into a structured report with proper source attribution.
This agent reviews the final report for errors and ensures quality standards are met.
